response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-relevant tools, plus strong architecture and DevOps exposure, but his title history (Senior/Staff) and 10+ years of experience far exceed the junior/mid-level role, raising concerns about fit, salary expectations, and potential disengagement in an entry-level environment.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven fullstack ownership from API to UI with clean architecture focus
Demonstrated DevOps and infrastructure skills (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS CDK)
concerns: Overqualified with 10+ years of senior experience for an entry-level role
Limited evidence of PostgreSQL use despite required familiarity
German language skill is only basic, but role requires high on-site presence
